nodes.label: instructor/__init__.py
nodes.desc: Module __getattr__ resolves _LAZY_IMPORTS on first access: Instructor, from_* factories, Mode, DSL helpers. Version 1.18.0.

nodes.label: compat shims
nodes.desc: Historical instructor.core.* modules are now 3-line shims that star re-export instructor.v2.core.* implementations.

nodes.label: Instructor
nodes.desc: Sync wrapper class: stores create_fn/mode/provider/kwargs, exposes on/off/clear hook registration and chat/completions aliases.

nodes.label: AsyncInstructor
nodes.desc: Async subclass overriding create/create_partial/create_iterable/create_with_completion with awaitable or async-generator versions.

nodes.label: Instructor.create
nodes.desc: create(response_model, messages, max_retries=3): rejects async validators, merges default kwargs, combines hooks, calls the patched create_fn.

nodes.label: create_with_completion
nodes.desc: Returns (model, raw_response) so callers can read token usage and provider metadata off the original completion object.

nodes.label: Hooks / HookName
nodes.desc: Hooks container emits completion:kwargs, completion:response, completion:error, completion:usage, parse:error and last-attempt events.

nodes.label: patch()
nodes.desc: Accepts an OpenAI client or a bare create callable, resolves chat.completions.create, validates mode registration and installs the wrapper.

nodes.label: patch_v2()
nodes.desc: Registry-driven patch core: checks RegistryValidationMixin.validate_mode_registration then picks sync or async wrapper.

nodes.label: _create_sync_wrapper
nodes.desc: new_create_sync: validates token budget, pops cache kwargs, injects default model, prepares request via handlers, applies templating, checks cache, then retries.

nodes.label: _create_async_wrapper
nodes.desc: Async twin of the sync wrapper; awaits retry_async_v2 and stores cached responses on success.

nodes.label: token budget
nodes.desc: _validate_token_budget checks the requested cumulative token budget; _budget_error aborts retries once the budget is exhausted.

nodes.label: handle_templating
nodes.desc: Renders Jinja-style message templates with the context dict before the request leaves the wrapper.

nodes.label: Mode
nodes.desc: Enum of ~40 strategies: TOOLS, TOOLS_STRICT, JSON, JSON_SCHEMA, RESPONSES_TOOLS plus ANTHROPIC_*, GEMINI_*, MISTRAL_*, COHERE_*, CEREBRAS_*, FIREWORKS_* variants.

nodes.label: Provider
nodes.desc: Provider enum (OPENAI, ANTHROPIC, GEMINI, LITELLM, ...) that together with Mode forms the registry key.

nodes.label: ModeRegistry
nodes.desc: Registry keyed by (Provider, Mode); supports eager register(), register_lazy() with a lock-guarded loader, and get_handlers(). Singleton mode_registry at module bottom.

nodes.label: ModeHandlers
nodes.desc: Dataclass bundle: request_handler, reask_handler, response_parser plus optional stream_extractors, message_converter and template_handler.

nodes.label: ModeHandler ABC
nodes.desc: Abstract base for provider handlers: prepare_request injects schema/tools into kwargs; handle_reask rebuilds kwargs after a failed attempt.

nodes.label: retry_sync_v2
nodes.desc: Tenacity Retrying with stop_after_attempt; each attempt calls func, snapshots usage, parses via registry handlers, and on ValidationError/json errors appends FailedAttempt and reasks.

nodes.label: retry_async_v2
nodes.desc: Async twin of retry_sync_v2 using AsyncRetrying; same parse/validate/reask contract for AsyncInstructor.

nodes.label: InstructorRetryException
nodes.desc: Raised when retries are exhausted: carries last_completion, n_attempts, total_usage, messages and the FailedAttempt history.

nodes.label: update_total_usage
nodes.desc: Accumulates per-attempt OpenAI CompletionUsage (or Anthropic Usage) into a running total attached to the final model as _total_usage.

nodes.label: process_response
nodes.desc: Main parsing dispatcher: normalizes mode/provider, marks streaming models, resolves registry handlers and returns the validated model with _raw_response attached.

nodes.label: prepare_response_model
nodes.desc: Normalizes the caller's type before the request: resolves annotations and adapts raw Python types into Pydantic models.

nodes.label: error taxonomy
nodes.desc: InstructorError hierarchy: IncompleteOutputException, ResponseParsingError, TokenBudgetError, AsyncValidationError, ProviderError, ModeError.

nodes.label: Partial
nodes.desc: Partial[Model] builds an all-Optional mirror of a Pydantic model so streaming chunks can be parsed incrementally; PartialBase drives stream handling.

nodes.label: IterableModel
nodes.desc: IterableModel(T) wraps a tasks list schema; IterableBase extracts individual tasks from a single streamed completion.

nodes.label: ModelAdapter
nodes.desc: Adapter that lets response_model be a bare Python type (str, int, list[str], Literal) instead of a BaseModel.

nodes.label: ResponseSchema
nodes.desc: Base for tool-call models: openai_schema/anthropic_schema/gemini_schema class properties and from_response delegating to the registry parser. response_schema() wraps any model.

nodes.label: extract_json_from_codeblock
nodes.desc: Pulls JSON out of markdown fences or raw text for JSON-mode parsers; extract_json_from_stream handles chunked output.

nodes.label: from_openai
nodes.desc: Validates the OpenAI client, applies mode normalization, patches chat.completions.create (or responses.create) and returns Instructor/AsyncInstructor.

nodes.label: from_anthropic
nodes.desc: Patches Anthropic messages.create with ANTHROPIC_TOOLS/ANTHROPIC_JSON handlers and wraps the result in Instructor.

nodes.label: from_provider
nodes.desc: Splits 'provider/model', maps provider names to client constructors, passes api_key/cache through and returns the ready client.

nodes.label: OpenAI handlers
nodes.desc: handle_tools/handle_json request builders plus reask_tools, reask_default, reask_md_json that rebuild the request with the validation error appended.
